rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables macOS users to wrap any CLI command as a persistent MCP tool through a native GUI application or CLI interface. Supports SSH tunnel configuration for remote tool access and integrates with macOS Keychain for secure credential storage. Runs as a stdio daemon server compatible with Claude Desktop and other MCP clients.
